description: Add a Cardio tab to the dashboard for logging daily cardio sessions (date + minutes + optional note) with weekly total tracking. Purely manual via SQLDelight — no health-platform sync.

userStories.title: Cardio schema + repository
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to store cardio sessions in the local database so they persist across app restarts.
acceptanceCriteria: New CardioSession.sq file under sqldelight/com/mettyoung/fitbro/data/db/ with cardio_session table: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, date TEXT NOT NULL (YYYY-MM-DD), minutes INTEGER NOT NULL, note TEXT (nullable)
Migration 5.sqm created under db/migrations/ with the CREATE TABLE statement
CardioSession domain model in data/model/ with fields: id Long, date String, minutes Int, note String?

CardioRepository interface in data/repository/ with: logSession(date, minutes, note), updateSession(id, date, minutes, note), deleteSession(id), sessionsForRange(startDate, endDate): Flow<List<CardioSession>>
CardioRepositoryImpl backed by SQLDelight, all suspend ops use withContext(Dispatchers.Default), Flow ops use .asFlow().mapToList(Dispatchers.Default)
Typecheck passes: compileDebugKotlinAndroid + compileKotlinIosSimulatorArm64

userStories.title: Cardio tab + CardioStateHolder wiring
userStories.description: As a user, I want a dedicated Cardio tab on the dashboard so I can access my cardio log without leaving the app.
acceptanceCriteria: CardioState data class: sessions: List<CardioSession>, weeklyTotalMinutes: Int

CardioStateHolder in ui/dashboard/ receives CardioRepository + CoroutineScope; exposes StateFlow<CardioState>; collects sessionsForRange(today-6, today) reactively using kotlinx.datetime Clock.System.todayIn(TimeZone.currentSystemDefault())
CardioScreen composable stub in ui/dashboard/ that accepts CardioStateHolder; renders placeholder Text('Cardio') for now
Cardio tab added to DashboardWithTabs tab row after existing tabs; tab body renders CardioScreen
CardioRepositoryImpl instantiated in App.kt via remember {}; CardioStateHolder wired in and passed to CardioScreen
Selecting the Cardio tab does not affect other tabs' state
Typecheck passes: compileDebugKotlinAndroid + compileKotlinIosSimulatorArm64

userStories.title: Weekly summary header
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see my total cardio minutes for the current week at the top of the Cardio tab so I know where I stand.
acceptanceCriteria: Header card in CardioScreen displays 'This week: X min' where X = weeklyTotalMinutes from CardioState
Shows 'This week: 0 min' when no sessions logged
Card style consistent with MacroSummaryCard (same elevation, padding, Material3 card surface)
Updates reactively: changing sessions flow in StateHolder propagates to header without manual refresh
Typecheck passes: compileDebugKotlinAndroid + compileKotlinIosSimulatorArm64

userStories.title: Per-day session list
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see my cardio sessions grouped by day so I can review what I logged on each day this week.
acceptanceCriteria: Sessions from CardioState.sessions listed below the header card, grouped by date, most recent day first
Day header row shows formatted date label (e.g. 'Mon Jun 9') using LocalDate.parse + dayOfWeek short name
Each session row shows: minutes (e.g. '30 min') and note if present (secondary text below)
Days with no sessions are not shown
Tapping a session row calls an onSessionClick(CardioSession) lambda (dialog wired in US-005; for now pass a no-op lambda from parent)
Row style consistent with existing diary entry rows (Card, HorizontalDivider between day groups, Material3 typography)
Typecheck passes: compileDebugKotlinAndroid + compileKotlinIosSimulatorArm64

userStories.title: Log / edit / delete session dialog
userStories.description: As a user, I want to log a new cardio session or edit/delete an existing one so I can keep my data accurate.
acceptanceCriteria: FAB ('+') on Cardio tab opens a ModalBottomSheet log dialog with: date field (DatePickerDialog, defaults today), minutes OutlinedTextField (KeyboardType.Number, whole numbers only, required), note OutlinedTextField (optional free text)
Tapping an existing session row opens the same dialog pre-filled with that session's data; dialog shows a 'Delete' TextButton (destructive color) in addition to Save/Cancel
Save validates minutes > 0; shows inline error text below the field if blank or zero

Save calls stateHolder.logSession or stateHolder.updateSession; Delete calls stateHolder.deleteSession; StateHolder launches coroutines that update the sessionsForRange flow which propagates to list + header immediately
logSession/updateSession/deleteSession suspend funs added to CardioStateHolder, launched in the holder's scope
FAB color: MiOrange; FAB icon: Icons.Default.Add
Dialog dismisses on Save/Delete/Cancel
Typecheck passes: compileDebugKotlinAndroid + compileKotlinIosSimulatorArm64
